Plasterers and Stucco Masons


About the Role
Apply interior or exterior plaster, cement, stucco, or similar materials. May also set ornamental plaster.
What You'll Do
Cover surfaces such as windows, doors, or sidewalks to protect from splashing.
Mix mortar and plaster to desired consistency or direct workers who perform mixing.
Apply coats of plaster or stucco to walls, ceilings, or partitions, using trowels, brushes, or spray guns.
Set up scaffolds for working at heights.
Apply weatherproof, decorative coverings to exterior surfaces of buildings.
Clean and prepare surfaces for applications of plaster, cement, stucco, or similar materials.
Create decorative textures in finish coat, using brushes or trowels.
Apply insulation to building exteriors by installing prefabricated insulation systems.


Tools & Technology
Cost estimating software (Project management software)
Microsoft Excel (Spreadsheet software)
Education & Experience
Education: Less than high school diploma or High school diploma or equivalent
On-the-Job Training: Up to 1 month
Work Environment
Outdoors, exposed to all weather conditions
Wear safety equipment
Importance of being exact or accurate
Exposed to noise
